Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vikram - 42 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Ayaan stands on the road. Anita and Vikram stand near him.]

Anita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Ayaan sits in the back seat.]

Ayaan: "Yes, of course."

[Ayaan sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Ayaan: "Mom, listen!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Ayaan in the back.]

Anita: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Vikram stand near him.]

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan slips and falls.]

Anita: "That's great!"

[Ayaan trips over a stone.]

Ayaan: "Let's see."

[Ayaan hurts his knee.]

Ayaan: "That's great!"

[Ayaan helps Mother get up.]

Ayaan: "Yes, of course."

[Ayaan sneezes loudly.]

Ayaan: "Okay, Dad."

[Ayaan coughs.]

Anita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
